subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should the general agent write tool gain a durable model-facing `append` mode, with sandbox semantics documented as queued read-modify-write rather than cross-process atomic append?
rationale: The concrete backend defect is mechanically repairable, but accepting a new model/tool backend contract and weaker sandbox concurrency semantics requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Land the optional parameter after stable sandbox missing-file handling, real bridge regression coverage, and final-head behavior proof.

options.title: Require atomic sandbox append
options.body: Delay the feature until the sandbox bridge exposes a guarded native append primitive equivalent to host and workspace semantics.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only write
options.body: Decline the durable tool expansion and pursue another product workflow for append-only state.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Land the optional parameter after stable sandbox missing-file handling, real bridge regression coverage, and final-head behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current agent filesystem and sandbox integration history makes this the strongest available owner for the API and semantic choice.
